BALOCHISTAN CIVIL DEFENCE DEPARTMENT
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL DEFENCE DEPARTMENT
(GRADE-16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1982
(Substitution of Appendix)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
23rd November, 2012]
No.SO(R-II)(9)32/2012-S&GAD/2454-2503, dated 23-11-2012.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 25 of the Balochistan Civil
Servants Act, 1974 (Act No.IX of 1974), the Government of Balochistan is
pleased to make the following amendments in the Balochistan Civil Defence
Department (Grade-16 and above) Service Rules, 1982 namely:--
In
the aforesaid rules, for the existing Appendix the following shall be
substituted,---
